text:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS

The water supply will be [1] on Saturday, April 12, from 8 a.m. to noon. This interruption is necessary [2] the pipes in the basement must be repaired. [3] We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Residents are advised to store enough water for the morning. If you have any questions, please [4] the building manager.

questions.explanation: The repair of the pipes is the reason for the interruption.

choices: The work should be completed by early afternoon.
Rent is due on the first of each month.
Parking is available behind the building.
questions.explanation: The sentence continues the announcement about the planned repair work and its timing.
After 'please', the base form of the verb is used.
